Restore project artefact directories

Source: R/restore-repo.R, R/restore.R
projr_content_update.Rd

projr_content_update() is deprecated. Use projr_source(), which it now calls with the latest version and cue = "always". projr_restore_repo() clones a GitHub repository and then fetches its directories with projr_source().

Usage

projr_restore_repo(
  repo,
  path = NULL,
  label = NULL,
  pos = NULL,
  type = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  destination = NULL
)

projr_restore_repo_wd(
  repo,
  label = NULL,
  pos = NULL,
  type = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  destination = NULL
)

projr_content_update(
  label = NULL,
  pos = NULL,
  type = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  clear = FALSE,
  destination = NULL
)

Arguments

repo

character. GitHub repository ("owner/repo" or "repo"). (Only for repository restoration functions.)

path

character or NULL. Local path for cloning the repository. Default is NULL, creating a subdirectory named after the repo. "." restores directly into the current directory.

label

character vector or NULL. Directory labels to restore. Default is NULL, restoring every declared raw directory.

pos

Ignored. Kept for compatibility.

type

character or NULL. Remote type, "local" or "github", used with title to name the remote as <type>:<title>.

title

character or NULL. Title of a remote registered under remotes. Default is NULL, using build.source or the single registered remote that published each label.

destination

No longer supported. Must be NULL; projr_source() reads the address of the registered remote.

clear

logical. If TRUE, local changes are replaced (conflict = "remote"). Otherwise, local changes stop the restore (conflict = "error"). Default is FALSE.

Value

Invisibly returns TRUE. projr_restore_repo() returns FALSE if cloning or restoration fails.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Fetch raw directories in an existing project
projr_source()

# Clone repository into subdirectory and restore artefacts
projr_restore_repo("owner/repo")

# Clone to specific path
projr_restore_repo("owner/repo", path = "my-project")

# Clone repository into current directory and restore artefacts
projr_restore_repo_wd("owner/repo")
} # }
